summary: The legal array contains at most 50 values, which is too small for a reliable asymptotic runtime-scaling verdict.

workload_bound.source_constraint: The source contract fixes nums.length between 1 and 50 and every value between 1 and 50.

replacement_checks.evidence: The implementation builds one frequency map, scans the array once, and performs constant expected-time set or map work per element.
Regression compares against independently rebuilt prefix and suffix sets for every array of length at most six over values one through four.
Regression also checks maximum-length all-equal, all-distinct, and periodic arrays at the legal length bound.
